sloka: सा भूमिर्बहुभिर्यानै: खुरनेमिसमाहता ।मुमोच तुमुलं शब्दं द्यौरिवाभ्रसमागमे ॥ २.१०२.४०॥
transliteration: sā bhūmirbahubhiryānai: khuranemisamāhatā ।mumoca tumulaṁ śabdaṁ dyaurivābhrasamāgame ॥ 2.102.40॥

translations.english: The earth crushed by several vehicles, hooves (of horses) and wheels (of chariots) emitted tumultuous sounds like the sky in the gathering stormclouds.
